title: 恐龙想跟你玩
subtitle: 千万别对恐龙说「不行」
character: wearing a green t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, loose sketchy pencil lines with soft transparent watercolour washes, lots of plain white paper around the figures, muted faded colours, simple rounded characters with small dot eyes and calm deadpan expressions, no words, no letters and no writing anywhere in the picture, leaf green, sand and soft brick red

pages.zh:
嘿，小朋友。
你知道恐龙最想干什么吗？
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing in a backyard, looking curious, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 找人玩。
pages.scene: A small triceratops peeking around a tree trunk, looking for someone

pages.zh:
恐龙交朋友的办法
很奇怪。
pages.scene: Two of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes standing nose to nose, studying each other

pages.zh: 先闻一闻你。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes sniffing the top of another one's head

pages.zh: 再甩一甩尾巴。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes wagging its tail happily

pages.zh:
最后，把它最喜欢的
那块石头送给你。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes holding out a smooth round stone

pages.zh:
收到石头，就是说：
我们是朋友了。
pages.scene: Two of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes sitting side by side, a round stone between them

pages.zh:
霸王龙问「我可以一起玩吗」
的时候，嗓门太大了。
pages.scene: A T. rex with its mouth wide open, leaves blowing off a tree in front of it

pages.zh: 树叶全被吹掉了。
pages.scene: A completely bare tree, leaves piled on the ground, a T. rex looking sheepish

pages.zh:
三角龙玩滑梯，
角会卡住。
pages.scene: A triceratops stuck halfway down a playground slide by its horns

pages.zh:
所以它最会排队，
从来不挤。
pages.scene: The soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes waiting in a neat line at a slide, a triceratops at the back

pages.zh:
长脖子恐龙最会轮流：
让大家一个一个，
从它的脖子上滑下来。
pages.scene: A long-necked dinosaur bending its neck like a slide while small dinosaurs slide down one at a time

pages.zh: 不过，你一定要记住一件事。
pages.scene: One small triceratops sitting alone in the middle of white paper, looking at the viewer

pages.zh:
千万别对恐龙说「不行！」
然后扭头就走。
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes with drooping head looking at a trail of footprints walking away

pages.zh:
恐龙一听见「不行」，
就会把尾巴一盘，
脑袋一缩——
pages.scene: One of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes curling up tight, tucking in its head and tail

pages.zh:
变成一块大石头。
谁也搬不动。
pages.scene: A large round grey boulder shaped like a curled-up dinosaur, the tip of a tail peeking out

pages.zh:
星期天，他在院子里
用积木搭恐龙城堡。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, building a castle of wooden blocks on the grass in the backyard, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
他搭到最要紧的一层，
一块一块，小心又小心。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, carefully placing one block on top of a tall block castle, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
一只小三角龙走过来，
捧着一块圆石头。
「我也想玩。」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, busy with his block castle while a small triceratops walks up holding a round stone, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
他一着急，
张嘴就说——
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, turning towards a small triceratops, his mouth opening, one hand up, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 「不行！」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, holding one arm out in front of his block castle, a small triceratops startled in front of him, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 小三角龙一缩——
pages.scene: A small triceratops curling up tight, tucking in its head

pages.zh:
变成了一块大石头，
正好堵住城堡的门。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, staring at a big round boulder sitting in front of the door of his block castle, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
别的恐龙来了，一看——
也都缩成了石头。
pages.scene: More of the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes arriving in the backyard and curling up into boulders

pages.zh:
一块、两块、十块……
院子里全是石头。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, standing in the middle of a backyard full of big round boulders, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 他推也推不动。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, pushing a big round boulder with all his strength, cheeks puffed, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh: 叫也叫不醒。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, calling out to a big round boulder with his hands around his mouth, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
他想起来了：
恐龙听不得「不行」，
可是听得懂「等一下」。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting on the grass beside a boulder with his chin in his hand, thinking, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
他蹲下来，小声说：
「对不起，我刚才正在搭。
等我搭完这一块，
你来搭屋顶，好吗？」
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, crouching beside a big round boulder, speaking to it softly, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
咔嚓！
石头裂开了，
小三角龙跳了出来。
pages.scene: A boulder cracking open and a small triceratops popping out of it happily

pages.zh:
大家一起搭。
城堡比原来大了三倍。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, building an enormous block castle together with the soft rounded friendly cartoon dinosaurs with small dot eyes, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural

pages.zh:
现在你知道了：
有人想跟你玩的时候，别说「不行」。
说「等一下」，再给他一件事做。
下次有小朋友来找你，你也试试。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up, sitting on top of a big block castle next to a small triceratops at sunset, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural
